description: Entirely invented events, company exposures and expected answers. These are not reports about NVIDIA or real market conditions.

evidence.quote: In this invented scenario, CloudHarbor is a customer of NVIDIA AI accelerators. Its AI infrastructure spending can affect accelerator demand, but no conversion from spending to NVIDIA sales is supplied.
In this invented scenario, X100 accelerator sales to Orion account for 12% of NVIDIA annual revenue. Orion and X100 are fictional.
In this invented scenario, advanced packaging is a necessary input to NVIDIA accelerator shipments. No supplier capacity or revenue sensitivity is quantified.

documents.title: [SYNTHETIC] CloudHarbor raises its AI infrastructure plan
documents.text: [SYNTHETIC] CloudHarbor announced that its FY2027 AI infrastructure budget is now USD 24 billion, compared with its previously announced USD 20 billion plan. No accelerator procurement allocation or market consensus is supplied.
documents.claim_quote: its FY2027 AI infrastructure budget is now USD 24 billion, compared with its previously announced USD 20 billion plan

baseline.quote: USD 24 billion, compared with its previously announced USD 20 billion plan

documents.title: [SYNTHETIC] CloudHarbor corrects its budget announcement
documents.text: [SYNTHETIC] CloudHarbor corrected its FY2027 AI infrastructure budget to USD 21 billion, compared with its previously announced USD 20 billion plan. The earlier USD 24 billion figure was an error. No accelerator procurement allocation or market consensus is supplied.

documents.text: [SYNTHETIC] A fictional regulator announced an immediately effective prohibition on NVIDIA X100 accelerator shipments to Orion. No exemption, replacement revenue or earlier market expectation is supplied.
